reason.why: The core value is live market-data streaming and real order routing to an exchange. That is real-time external connectivity and execution, not stateful records an agent reads and changes through an API. A deterministic world cannot supply live quotes or real exchange fills. What would make it feasible: Ask for a brokerage order-management API over stored records, such as an Alpaca-style paper-trading desk. It would hold accounts, instruments, quote snapshots, orders and positions. Agents would place, amend and cancel orders, and orders would move through new, filled and canceled states.
